programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Kristi said it was love at first sight when she met Michael. They married, had three kids, but when the union went awry nine years later, they divorced, and are now in an all-out war affecting the most vulnerable members of the family — the children.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil goes into his mailbag to answer viewers' popular questions! He has help from commedienne and author Teresa Strasser. When Teresa talks to moms on the street, find out their biggest parenting and pregnancy queries. Update on Ted Williams.

programme.title: Lay Down Your Heart
programme.desc: An accomplished artist, a lifelong performer and a person with Down syndrome, Niall McNeil has built a unique family tree of blood and chosen relations made up of his closest friends and collaborators.

programme.title: Junior

programme.title: How They Saw Us Wings On Her Shoulder
programme.desc: This is a 1943 recruitment film. Although it specifically promises women jobs in post-war aviation, its primary message is that women fulfill support positions "so that men might fly."

programme.title: Nails

programme.title: Voices Across The Water
programme.desc: ‘Voices Across the Water’ follows two master boat builders as they practise their art and find a way back to balance and healing.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: The finals continue in Las Vegas where the ninjas face up to eight supersized obstacles; the competitors face a split decision between a grueling upper body obstacle or a riskier balance obstacle in hopes of advancing to the last stage of the finals.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: The national finals conclude in Las Vegas as the remaining competitors move on to Stage 2 and beyond for their chance to win $1 million and become the next American Ninja Warrior.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: Twelve elite female competitors battle across two daunting courses; the top 4 finishers advance to race head-to-head on the Power Tower, with the winner taking home $50,000 and becoming the second American Ninja Warrior Women's Champion.
